bio.text: Joyce Mason, a Democrat, has represented Illinois's 61st House District since January 2019.
According to the General Assembly biography, Mason is a former vice president of the Woodland Community School District 50 Board of Education in Gurnee and a human resources consultant.
The biography says Mason holds a B.A. from the University of Illinois at Chicago and an M.B.A. from Keller Graduate School of Management.
